Up to 70 000 people took on the streets of #Brussels today for the #climate strike.

The first mobilization since the pandemic exceeded all expectations and sent a strong message to leaders ahead of #COP26 🌍

What a moment of unity ✊🏼 #BackToTheClimate https://t.co/cUN1HapgXq

UN Special Rapporteur @cvoule: 

States must recognize #climatedefenders and ensure enabling environment for them, as they are the actors working to achieve the goals that States set for themselves in reversing the #climatecrisis 🌎

The countdown to #COP26 is on, and the pressure for leaders to deliver is building up 📣🌎

The only way out of the #climate crisis is by ensuring the participation and leadership of women & gender diverse people.

Stay tuned for more info on #feminist climate actions at COP26!
